name: Donald MacLean Jr.
bio:
Donald MacLean Jr. is an actor and writer, known for Nurses (2020), Workin' Moms (2017) and The Craft.

He was born in Canada, but he was about six months old when his family moved to Mexico. After nearly seven years, their travels brought him to Ajax and eventually Oshawa, Ont. He now calls North York, Ont. home.

credits.title: Rotten
credits.overview: A middling rock band nearing the end of its brief prime refuses to play a show because no one appreciates their new music. Their manager must convince them to play for the awaiting crowd.

credits.overview: Freddy and Charlie on the road.

credits.overview: A feud between a hospice cleaner and a blind resident takes a turn when a mischievous act sparks something neither could have expected.

credits.overview: Johnny heads to a summer camp, where he crosses paths with a young, outcast camper who is forced to spend the night with his counselor sister and her friends at their annual end-of-season party

credits.title: Youngblood
credits.overview: Hockey prodigy Dean Youngblood joins the Hamilton Mustangs and has to deal with toxic behavior during his journey to the National Hockey League draft.

credits.title: Pink Light
credits.overview: Inspired by his real life, Harrison Browne’s self-assured directorial debut follows an ex-pro hockey player who time travels back to his pre-transitioned self, when he was waiting for life to begin — only to realize that he has always been the person he was waiting to become.

credits.title: Masterpiece
credits.overview: Margo, a struggling painter, risks losing everything when the revelation of an affair threatens her future. After an uninvited guest arrives at her dinner party, she confronts the sins and secrets of her past in a chaotic, hilarious evening of misunderstandings and heartbreaks.
